desc: Derive and verify the edge-contribution coefficients for cases i < u, i = u, u < i < v, and i = v, including u = 1 and adjacent u, v, and produce a closed-form query formula using prefix sums.
Implement input parsing and precompute factorial (N-1)!, modular inverses up to N, and A_i modulo 998244353.
Build prefix sums S1[k] = sum_{i=2..k} A_i / i and S2[k] = sum_{i=2..k} A_i * 2(i-1)/(i(i+1)).
For each query, compute the expected distance from the prefix sums and endpoint terms, multiply by (N-1)!, and print modulo 998244353.
Test edge cases such as u = 1, v = u+1, large N, and the provided samples.
